# DeepBridge Advisory

> DeepBridge supports industrial businesses through SAP transformation, operational improvement and interim leadership. We bring together experienced professionals, define the assignment and stay involved through delivery, coordination and handover. European focus: London · Munich · Madrid, with particular attention to industrial programmes in Germany.

The website operator is DEEPBRIDGE ADVISORY LTD, company number 16775578, registered in England and Wales. The registered office is 71–75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom. The European city line describes strategic focus, not a claim of three physical offices.

## Expertise

- [SAP & Business Transformation](https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/expertise): SAP S/4HANA programmes, business processes, planning, operational data, Power BI reporting and workstream coordination.
- [Operations & Supply Chain](https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/expertise): planning, production, logistics, inventory, order-to-delivery improvement and operational stabilisation.
- [Interim Leadership & Finance](https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/expertise): interim management, finance and controlling, programme leadership, transformation PMO and operational coordination.

Specific capability, availability, scope and deliverables are assessed for each assignment. These areas are not a claim of completed project experience in every listed discipline.

## How we work

Define the requirement and responsibilities; assemble relevant expertise; mobilise the assignment; oversee agreed progress reviews and issue coordination; transition through handover and continuity planning. The level of DeepBridge involvement is agreed for each assignment.

## Español

DeepBridge apoya a empresas industriales en la transformación SAP, la mejora operativa y la dirección interina. Reunimos a profesionales con experiencia, definimos el encargo y acompañamos la ejecución, la coordinación y el traspaso. Enfoque europeo: Londres · Múnich · Madrid. El grado de participación de DeepBridge se acuerda para cada encargo.

El operador del sitio web es DEEPBRIDGE ADVISORY LTD, registrada en Inglaterra y Gales con el número 16775578. Su domicilio social es 71–75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom.
